item.title: Fabián Yannantuoni extends Paladini Racing contract
item.description: Fabián Yannantuoni is going to remain with Paladini Racing for the 2026 TCR South America season as the team expands to four Lynk & Co 03 TCRs. Yannantuoni finished fifth overall this season and is going to continue racing alongside already confirmed team-mate Juan Àngel Rosso next year. item.title: Leonel Pernía to defend TCR South America title
item.description: Leonel Pernía will defend his TCR South America title in 2026 after re-signing with the Honda YPF Racing team for the new campaign.
